retrievalProfile.description: A nostalgic cinematic layout featuring a central full-body subject, a vintage vehicle, and a large ethereal face in the background, all unified by a warm sepia monochrome palette.
excludeWhen: modern minimalist flat vector styles are requested
high-contrast black and white photography is needed

recipe.visualDefinition: A multi-layered composition in warm sepia tones where a man and child walk toward the viewer in front of a classic car, while a large, translucent portrait of a man in a cowboy hat and sunglasses looms in the upper right background.
coreVisualRelationships: The large background face acts as a protective or haunting presence over the smaller figures.
The vintage car provides a horizontal anchor for the vertical subjects.
The typography is nested in the upper left negative space created by the background portrait.
Faded, vignetted edges blend the photographic elements into a clean white border.
coreInvariants: Monochromatic sepia or warm brown color grading across all photographic elements.
Soft-edged masking to blend multiple photographic layers.
High-waisted serif typography with tight letter spacing.

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Full-body figures are centered and mid-scale; background portrait is large-scale and offset to the right.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The vintage car serves as the mid-ground horizontal anchor.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes move from the large background face to the title text, then down to the walking figures.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Significant white space at the top and bottom edges creates a clean, framed look.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Warm sepia/brown for all photographic content.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep chocolate brown for primary typography.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Off-white/cream for highlights and background canvas.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation with a focus on mid-tone values and soft highlights.

letterConstructionRules: Tight kerning with occasional ligatures or overlaps
characterSpecificRedesigns: Lowercase 'a' is significantly smaller than the following capitalized word
Letters in the main title are tightly packed to create a block-like texture

composition.relationshipToImage: Overlays the background portrait's shoulder area

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Small-caps sans-serif or smaller serif for secondary metadata to maintain a classic editorial feel.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the high-waisted, classic serif feel with tight spacing.
Provides a similar weathered, cinematic serif look.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create a sepia-toned cinematic collage. In the center, a man in a plaid shirt and a young boy walk forward. Behind them is a 1950s sedan. In the upper right, blend a large, translucent face of a man wearing a cowboy hat and sunglasses. Fade the edges into a white background.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add the title in the upper left using a bold, high-contrast serif font in deep brown. Use tight leading and tracking so the words feel like a single graphic block.

verificationChecks: Is the color palette strictly sepia/brown?
Is the background face translucent and blended?
Is the typography a high-contrast serif?
Are the edges of the image softly faded?

adjustableVariables: Font weight of the display text
mustRedesign: Do not use trademarked car logos
Ensure the text is not a direct copy of the original title

avoid: Default system fonts like Arial or Times New Roman

postGenerationChecks: Check for smooth transitions between the car and the background.
Verify that the text is legible against the photographic background.
Ensure the sepia tone is uniform across all elements.
Confirm the composition feels balanced despite the asymmetrical layout.
recipe.reuseFormula: Cinematic Sepia + Double Exposure Portrait + Centered Walking Figures + High-Contrast Serif Typography
